title: The same group is both included and excluded on a profile
when: it.Assignments.Any(a => a.Included) && it.Assignments.Any(a => !a.Included && it.Assignments.Any(b => b.Included && b.GroupId == a.GroupId))

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile includes', 'profiles include')} and excludes the same group

messages.businessImpact: Exclusion wins, so the profile reaches nobody it appears to target. It looks deployed and does nothing.
remediation: Remove either the inclusion or the exclusion so the intent is visible from the assignment alone.
